sn41.8:1.1: Tena kho pana samayena Nigaṇṭho Nāṭaputto Macchikāsaṇḍam anuppatto hoti mahatiyā nigaṇṭhaparisāya saddhiṃ || || 3
sn41.8:1.2: Assosi kho Citto gahapati Nigaṇṭho kira Nāṭaputto Macchikāsaṇḍam anuppatto mahatiyā nigaṇṭhaparisāya saddhinti || || 4
sn41.8:1.3: Atha kho Citto gahapati sambahulehi upāsakehi saddhiṃ yena Nigaṇṭho Nāṭaputto tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Nigaṇṭhena Nāṭaputtena saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn41.8:1.4: sammodanīyam kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 5 Ekam antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Cittaṃ gahapatiṃ Nigaṇṭho Nāṭaputto etad avoca || ||
sn41.8:1.6: Atthi avitakko avicāro samādhi atthi vitakkavicārānaṃ nirodhoti || ||
sn41.8:2.1: Na khvāham ettha bhante Bhagavato saddhāya gacchāmi
sn41.8:2.2: Atthi avitakko avicaro samādhi atthi vitakkavicārānaṃ nirodhoti || || 6
sn41.8:2.3: Evaṃ vutte Nigaṇṭho Nāṭaputto sakam parisam ulloketvā etad avoca || ||
sn41.8:2.4: Idam bhavanto passantu yāva ujuko cāyam Citto gahapati yāva asaṭṭho cāyaṃ Citto gahapati yāva amāyāvī cāyaṃ Citto gahapati || vātaṃ vā so jālena bādhetabbam maññeyya yo vitakkavicāre nirodhetabbam maññeyya || sakamuṭṭhinā vā so Gaṅgāya sotam āvāretabbam maññeyya yo vitakkavicāre nirodhetabbam maññeyyāti || || 7
sn41.8:3.2: Katamam nu kho paṇītataram ñāṇam vā saddhā vā ti || ||
sn41.8:3.3: Saddhāya kho gahapati ñāṇam eva paṇītataranti || || 8
sn41.8:3.4: Aham kho bhante yāvadeva ākaṅkhāmi vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkam savicāraṃ vivekajam pītisukham pathamam jhānam upasampajja viharāmi || ||
sn41.8:3.5: Aham kho bhante yāvad eva ākaṅkhāmi vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā || pe || dutiyaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharāmi || ||
sn41.8:3.6: Ahaṃ kho bhante yāvad eva ākaṅkhāmi pītiyā ca virāgā || pe || tatiyaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharāmi || ||
sn41.8:3.7: Ahaṃ kho bhante yāvadeva ākaṅkhāmi sukhassa ca pahānā || pa || catuttham jhānam upasampajja viharāmi || ||
sn41.8:3.8: So khvāham bhante evaṃ jānanto evam passanto kassaññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā saddhāya gamissāmi
sn41.8:3.9: Atthi avitakko avicāro samādhi atthi vitakkavicārānaṃ nirodho ti || || 8
sn41.8:4.1: Evaṃ vutte Nigaṇṭho Nāṭaputto sakam parisam apaloketvā etad avoca || ||
sn41.8:4.2: Idam bhavanto passantu yāva anujuko cāyam Citto gahapati yāva saṭṭho cāyam Citto gahapati yāva māyāvī cāyaṃ Citto gahapatī ti || ||
sn41.8:5.1: Idāneva kho te pana mayam bhante bhāsitam
sn41.8:5.2: ājānāma || || Idam bhavanto passantu yāva ujuko cāyaṃ Citto gahapati yāva asaṭṭho cāyaṃ Citto gahapati yāva amāyāvī cāyaṃ Citto gahapatī ti || ||
sn41.8:5.3: Idāneva ca pana mayam bhante bhāsitam
sn41.8:5.4: evam ājānāma || || Idam bhavanto passantu yāva anujuko cāyaṃ Citto gahapati yāva saṭṭho cāyaṃ Citto gahapati yāva māyāvī cāyam Citto gahapatī ti || || 10
sn41.8:5.5: Sace te bhante purimaṃ saccam pacchimam te micchā ||
sn41.8:5.6: sace pana te bhante pacchimaṃ saccaṃ purimaṃ te micchā ||
sn41.8:5.7: ime kho pana bhante dasa sahadhammikā pañhā āgacchanti ||
sn41.8:5.8: yadā nesam attham ājāneyyasi || atha mam paṭihareyyāsi saddhiṃ nigaṇṭhaparisāya || ||
sn41.8:5.9: Eko pañho eko uddeso ekaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ ||
sn41.8:5.10: dve pañhā dve uddesā dve veyyākaraṇāni ||
sn41.8:5.11: tayo pañhā tayo uddesā tīṇi veyyākaraṇāni ||
sn41.8:5.12: cattāro pañho cattāro uddesā cattāri veyyakaraṇāni ||
sn41.8:5.13: pañca pañhā pañca uddesā pañca veyyākaraṇāni ||
sn41.8:5.14: cha pañhā cha uddesā cha veyyākaraṇāni ||
sn41.8:5.15: satta pañhā satta uddesā satta veyyākaraṇāni ||
sn41.8:5.16: aṭṭha pañhā aṭṭha uddesā aṭṭha veyyākaraṇāni ||
sn41.8:5.17: nava pañhā nava uddesā nava veyyākaraṇāni ||
sn41.8:5.18: dasa pañhā dasa uddesā dasa veyyākaraṇanī ti || || 11
sn41.8:5.19: Atha kho Citto gahapati Nigaṇṭhaṃ Nāṭaputtam ime dasa sahadhammike pañhe apucchitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmī
